about: XML entity decoding, applied to titles and descriptions.
notes: Only the five XML entities and numeric references. An HTML entity table is not part of XMLTV and decoding one would change text a feed meant literally.

cases.name: text with nothing to decode is unchanged
an ampersand that is not an entity is left alone
cases.why: Feeds write bare ampersands constantly; turning one into a replacement character is worse than leaving it.

cases.name: an unknown named entity is left alone
a doubly-escaped ampersand decodes once
cases.why: Decoding twice would turn `&lt;` into a tag and let a feed inject markup into the guide.
